parameters.question: Compare GSEA prerank results (GO_Biological_Process_2021, min_size=15, max_size=500). Match gene-set records by GO ID parsed from the Term string (e.g. GO:0002181), regardless of how the term name is formatted. Each record must match the reference's enrichment direction (sign of NES). NES may differ by up to 5% relative absolute error and FDR q-val by up to 10% relative absolute error, because GSEA uses permutations. Column order, row order and extra columns may differ.

Compare the top-10 GSEA enriched GO Biological Process gene sets. Parse the GO ID from the Term string (e.g. GO:0002181) and match rows by it. Enrichment direction (sign of NES) must agree, NES may differ by up to 5% relative absolute error, and rank may shift by +/-2 positions. Term name formatting and column order may differ.
